name: Arcane Ballistics
description:
A ranged arcane engineer's discipline. Electric bow-caster engineering: charged arrows, stationary coil turrets and conductive traps. Everything deals electricity damage and builds Shock; Magic Power grows with every turret standing.

Train at a Celestial Collegium or by using abilities.

Every level from 11 onward grants +1 statistic.

Level 30 grants Arcane Ballistics Mastery (+10% all attributes; stacks with other combat-branch masteries).

Ballistic Infusions enchant your bow with an element for 30 turns. Hits of that element put an elemental Charge on the target (Arcane = electricity from level 11, Frost, Astral = holy, Void = death); at 3 stacks the Charge releases a spell. Charges fade after 2 turns.
